messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a quiet routing cutover from eu-edge -> apac-edge tomorrow 05:00 UTC. Aim: 10% canary -> 50% steady over 30m. Need SRE + infra coverage and quick smoke checklist. Who can own what?

 dave: I can own the DNS/traffic side. Will update TTL and watch for propagation.

 cheng: I can run smoke checks and metrics validation. Please post the exact smoke steps.

 maria: Smoke checklist (short):
```
# 1) basic health across endpoints
for h in api-eu-1 api-eu-2 api-ap-1; do curl -fsS https://$h/health || echo FAIL:$h; done

# 2) sample request path to ensure model routing and KV cache warmed
curl -s -H 'x-region:apac' https://edge.example.com/predict -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq '.status'

# 3) metrics quick checks (via prometheus)
#   - kv_cache_hit_ratio > 0.85
#   - p90_latency_tokens_ms < 120
#   - 5xx rate < 0.1%
```
Post outputs in this thread. If any step fails, we rollback.

 priya: Rollback plan: revert routing policy to tag `v2026-03-12` (playbook at infra/playbooks/rollback-routing.md). I validated the revert playbook locally.

 deploy-bot: Scheduled operation ID=98765 for 2026-03-18T05:00:00Z. Canary=10% -> step to 50% at +30m.

 sre-bot: Notifying on-call channel #incidents and #observability. Setting alerts to high sensitivity for the window.

 dave: Plan for DNS TTL: set TTL=60s at t+5m after canary, then proceed to 50% at t+30m. If propagation issues, pause and escalate.

 cheng: I'll kick off the health loop and post results. If any host returns FAIL, we run rollback immediately and ping on-call.

 maria: Config reference: infra/routing/policies/eu-to-apac.yaml @ sha abc1234. Please confirm the git tag and that the deploy artifact is built.

 priya: Confirmed sha abc1234 and tag `v2026-03-18-quiet`. Artifact is in the registry: rg.prod/redwood/routing:v2026-03-18-quiet.

 dave: On-call for the window will be cheng; I will be nearby for DNS ops. cheng pls ack.

 cheng: ack. runbooks and playbooks pinned, Slack notifications unmuted.

 priya: I'll be ready for rollback steps and will open the playbook when needed. Also I recommend keeping roll-forward window short (<=45m) to limit exposure.

 maria: Sweet. I'll post a 30m reminder and then a 5m countdown. Quick question: should we enable prefix KV cache prefetch for apac targets? It increases burst but reduces cold misses. Opinions?

 dave: Prefetch yes for this cutover — we want lower latency during ramp. I'll enable prefetch at t-2m.

 cheng: agreed. I'll validate cache hit ratio after prefetch before going to 50%.

 maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone — final reminder will be here before the window. :rocket:
